title: Benchmarking residue-resolution protein coarse-grained models for simulations of biomolecular condensates.
authors: Feito, Alejandro; Sanchez-Burgos, Ignacio; Tejero, Ignacio; Sanz, Eduardo; Rey, Antonio; Collepardo-Guevara, Rosana; Tejedor, Andres R; Espinosa, Jorge R
one_liner_zh: 该文基准测试多种残基分辨率粗粒化模型模拟hnRNPA1低复杂度结构域凝聚体相行为，虽涉及蛋白-核酸相分离但非TF-DNA结合体系，方法可迁移至互作建模。
abstract: Intracellular liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) of proteins and nucleic acids is a fundamental mechanism by which cells compartmentalize their components and perform essential biological functions. Molecular simulations play a crucial role in providing microscopic insights into the physicochemical processes driving this phenomenon. In this study, we systematically compare six state-of-the-art sequence-dependent residue-resolution models to evaluate their performance in reproducing the phase behaviour and material properties of condensates formed by seven variants of the low-complexity domain (LCD) of the hnRNPA1 protein (A1-LCD)-a protein implicated in the pathological liquid-to-solid transition of stress granules. Specifically, we assess the HPS, HPS-cation-pi, HPS-Urry, CALVADOS2, Mpipi, and Mpipi-Recharged models in their predictions of the condensate saturation concentration, critical solution temperature, and condensate viscosity of the A1-LCD variants. Our analyses demonstrate that, among the tested models, Mpipi, Mpipi-Recharged, and CALVADOS2 provide accurate descriptions of the critical solution temperatures and saturation concentrations for the multiple A1-LCD variants tested. Regarding the prediction of material properties for condensates of A1-LCD and its variants, Mpipi-Recharged stands out as the most reliable model. Overall, this study benchmarks a range of residue-resolution coarse-grained models for the study of the thermodynamic stability and material properties of condensates and establishes a direct link between their performance and the ranking of intermolecular interactions these models consider.
abstract_zh: 细胞内蛋白质和核酸的液-液相分离（LLPS）是细胞区室化其组分并执行基本生物学功能的基本机制。分子模拟在提供驱动该现象的物理化学过程的微观见解方面发挥着关键作用。在本研究中，我们系统比较了六种最先进的序列依赖性残基分辨率模型，以评估它们在再现由hnRNPA1蛋白的低复杂度结构域（LCD）的七个变体（A1-LCD）形成的凝聚体的相行为及材料性质方面的性能——该蛋白与应激颗粒的病理性液-固态转变有关。具体而言，我们评估了HPS、HPS-cation-pi、HPS-Urry、CALVADOS2、Mpipi和Mpipi-Recharged模型在预测A1-LCD变体的凝聚体饱和浓度、临界溶液温度和凝聚体粘度方面的表现。我们的分析表明，在测试的模型中，Mpipi、Mpipi-Recharged和CALVADOS2对多个测试的A1-LCD变体的临界溶液温度和饱和浓度提供了准确的描述。在预测A1-LCD及其变体凝聚体的材料性质方面，Mpipi-Recharged脱颖而出，成为最可靠的模型。总体而言，本研究对一系列残基分辨率粗粒化模型进行了基准测试，用于研究凝聚体的热力学稳定性和材料性质，并建立了这些模型性能与其所考虑的分子间相互作用排序之间的直接联系。
